items.question: What is the annual cost of the basic health insurance package for private sector employees and domestic workers in the UAE?
items.gold: The basic insurance package costs AED 320 per year.
items.fact: Basic private sector worker health insurance package costs AED 320 yearly

items.question: What age range does the health insurance policy for private sector employees and domestic workers in the UAE cover?
items.gold: The policy covers individuals aged between 1 and 64 years.
items.fact: Private sector worker health insurance covers ages 1 to 64
